evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-cad — CAD Plugin for DeepSeek Harness

![dsh-cad banner](docs/img/banner.svg)

[![homepage](https://img.shields.io/badge/homepage-dsh--cad-4D6BFE)](https://lau-mars.github.io/dsh-cad/)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-cad)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cad)
[![downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-cad)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cad)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@deepseek-ai%2Fdsh?label=dsh)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D%2022-4D6BFE)](https://nodejs.org/)
[![occt](https://img.shields.io/badge/occt-7.9.3-4D6BFE)](https://github.com/LAU-MARS/opencascade-ts)
[![occt.ts](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/occt.ts?label=occt.ts)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/occt.ts)
[![ansatz](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/ansatz-wasm?label=ansatz)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ansatz-wasm)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-4D6BFE)](./LICENSE)

English | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

A CAD plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness):
an **embedded 3D/2D CAD viewer** plus a **native parametric modeling tool family**
(OCCT kernel) in the Web UI, letting the agent build and inspect CAD geometry
step by step — "model while you watch".

## Preview

A full modeling session, end to end: the agent builds a parametric assembly
from plain chat — a 120×80×8 base plate with R5 rounded corners, then four
bolt instances placed at the corners — while the resident CAD panel tracks
every step live (parts tree with per-instance colors, ViewCube, "装配体"
assembly tab, 5 instances · 1,740 triangles). The finished assembly exports
as a structured STEP document and the agent verifies it by reading the file
back — 2 solids, 3 products, 2 assembly usages, 1,125.00 mm³:

![dsh-cad assembly session](docs/img/assembly-preview.png)

## Downloads

Cumulative downloads from the npm registry, refreshed daily by CI:

![npm cumulative downloads](docs/img/downloads-cumulative.svg)

## Feature Overview

| Capability | Description |
| --- | --- |
| ⚙️ Kernel chain: cadorange → occt.ts | Modeling goes through **[cadorange](https://github.com/LAU-MARS/cadorange)** (the agent-native CAD runtime wrapping the occt.ts/OCCT WASM; public API + the supported `cadorange/occt` escape hatch for meshing/HLR/wire construction); the direct occt.ts adapter stays as the fallback tier — `DSH_CAD_KERNEL` pins one explicitly (the opencascade.js tier was removed in v0.15.1, −64MB install). The old "no editing after shell" seam is gone — fillet/chamfer/boolean keep working after shelling |
| 🔍 CAD viewing | STL / OBJ / STEP / IGES / BREP / DCPRT (3D), DXF / SVG (2D); interactive viewport in the resident right panel (orbit / zoom / wireframe / pan), with a one-line result row in the conversation |
| 🌗 Dark-mode surfaces | Every rendered surface follows the host theme — viewport slab, DXF/drawing strokes, the Three.js grid / XYZ triad / feature edges / default mesh color / sketch overlays, and the ViewCube plate; a theme flip restyles mounted viewers live. Overrides: `--dsh-cad-bg`, `--dsh-cad-stroke`, `--dsh-cad-paper` |
| 🧭 CAD editor interactions | Onshape-style ViewCube (26-zone click-to-orient), hover/click face & edge picking with live measurement (area mm² / length mm), Faces+Edges / Faces / Wireframe render modes, switchable BRep demo parts (bracket / flange / shaft) |
| 🏗️ Parametric modeling | Primitives, profile extrusion, **loft**, **sweep**, **revolve**, booleans, all-edge fillet/chamfer, **shell**, **draft**, **patterns** (linear/circular), transforms; profiles take **curve segments** (arcs/circles exact BRep; B-splines sampled approximation) — exact OCCT BRep, not a mesh approximation. `cad_loft` sections accept **curves** too: point loops, `{through}` splines or planar `{profile}` chains; `smooth: true` fits a **periodic B-spline** through point loops — one continuous B-spline lateral face instead of planar strips meeting at G0 creases |
| ✏️ Named sketches | Standalone named profiles (Sketch1…) kept in the document (`cad_sketch_new` / `edit` / `list` / `delete`); extrude/revolve/sweep reference them **by name**, and `cad_sketch_edit` rewrites the definition in place + replays the log, rebuilding every dependent feature — the parametric loop. Sketches render as Onshape-style **blue curves + plane frame** in the viewport (refreshing live on edit), listed in a left-side **feature tree** (sketches + features, eye-toggle visibility, click-to-highlight bodies) over the Part tab |
| 🗂️ Codex-style document tabs | The resident display panel gets a tab strip with a "+" menu: **Part** (Part Studio, the default) / **Assembly** (instance insert/move/remove) / **Drawing** (true hidden-line sheets); tabs are closable and keep their state |
| 📁 Multi-document file space | Named documents per workspace (`.dsh-cad/docs/`), each session bound to its own active document — new sessions start empty instead of inheriting leftovers; a folder button in the panel lists every document (preview / delete), and `cad_doc_new` / `cad_doc_open` manage the modeling target from chat |
| 📐 Engineering drawings | GB first-angle layout: front / top / left views + isometric, true OCCT hidden-line removal via the **occt.ts** kernel (an npm dependency, dashed); sheet frame, title block, overall dimensions, standard scale series; exports SVG / DXF |
| 🔗 Constraint solving & motion | **Ansatz** geometric constraint solver (**one command: `npm install ansatz-wasm`** — a wasm dependency, no Rust toolchain, no native binary): entity/constraint modeling (assembly instances ↔ rigid3 poses mapped automatically), solve-with-writeback, full DOF/residual/redundancy/suggestion diagnostics (LLM-oriented), and parametric kinematic sweeps (`cad_constraint` / `cad_solve` / `cad_motion`) |
| 📐 Geometry measurement | Exact volume (mm³), bounding box, triangle counts, DXF layers |
| 📤 On-demand export | STEP (parametric) / STL (mesh); files are written only when the user asks |
| 🖥️ Resident CAD panel | A permanent panel right of the conversation: Codex-style tabs (Part / Assembly / Drawing), tracking the latest model in real time while modeling. A host-independent liveness poll (`GET /dsh-cad/docs` → per-document op count) keeps the viewport following modeling ops even when the conversation meta pipeline goes stale, and auto-returns from a file preview |
| ⚡ Zero-copy render pipeline | worker mesh → in-memory binary → three.js typed arrays; zero base64 / zero intermediate files / zero per-step disk writes |
| 💾 Modeling document persistence | Operation log (JSON) + debounced disk mirror; automatically replayed to restore state after a process restart |
| 🖼️ Image → profile | PNG sketch/screenshot → Otsu binarization → contour tracing → extrusion-ready polygon (`cad_image_profile`) |
| 🔌 FreeCAD executor | Run the same op family on an external FreeCAD console (STEP in/out); requires a local FreeCAD install |
| ☁️ Onshape executor | Run the same op family on **Onshape** over its signed REST API — zero local install; every op compiles to a **standard Onshape feature** pushed into the target Part Studio (no Feature Studio setup). Readback is three-tier: cheap per-part STL by default, `readback: "step"` for exact-BRep-derived named meshes via a server-side STEP translation, or `readback: "none"` — build only and return the document link (~3 calls, quota-friendliest). Exports `.stl` / `.step` / `.x_t` (Parasolid). Quota-aware errors distinguish credential problems from free-plan cooldowns; the Onshape document URL is always surfaced |

## Installation

The plugin is published to npm — one line:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cad
```

The installer applies the bundled `cordis.patch.yml` (declared in the `dsh.bundle` manifest) automatically, so there is nothing to configure by hand.

### Version requirements

- **Node.js** and **dsh CLI** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh`): minimum versions live in
  the badge row above and the `engines` field of `package.json` — kept out of
  the prose so they never go stale

### Install from source (dev mode)

```sh
git clone https://github.com/LAU-MARS/dsh-cad.git
cd dsh-cad
npm install && npm run build && npm test   # deps include occt.ts (true-HLR drawing kernel, ~20MB wasm)

npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh pnpm
dsh web                                  # let the first launch init the profile, then Ctrl-C

dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-cad

dsh web
```

The patch insert ships as `cordis.patch.yml` in the package root and is applied by the installer via the same `dsh.bundle` manifest.

Set `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` and you are ready — for example:

- “open bracket.stl” → `cad_view`
- “model a 100×60×5 plate, punch a ⌀20 hole in the middle, R2 fillets on the four
  corners, add a ⌀16 boss 20 tall, export plate.step”
  → `cad_create_prim` + `cad_boolean` + `cad_fillet` + `cad_export`, with the 3D tab
  updating live at every step
- “build a snowman” → spheres + a cone nose + a cylinder hat (precise `at`/`axis` placement)
- “add two more b1, one rotated 90 degrees” → `cad_assembly_insert` + `cad_assembly_move`, the Assembly tab updates live
- “make an A3 drawing of b1 and export dxf” → `cad_drawing` (three views + iso + dashed hidden lines + dimensions) → `cad_export` `.dxf`

## Modeling Tool Family

| Tool | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cad_view` | Open a CAD file and render it in the viewer (resident panel) |
| `cad_info` | Read-only geometry metadata (format / counts / bounding box / units / layers) |
| `cad_create_prim` | Primitives (mm, Z-up); `at` for placement, `axis` for orientation (exact axis-angle rotation) |
| `cad_sketch_new` | Create a named sketch (Sketch1…): {start, segments} / {circle} / flat points loop — referenced by name from the profile features |
| `cad_sketch_edit` | Redefine a sketch (回改): the definition op is rewritten in place and the log replayed — every referencing feature rebuilds |
| `cad_sketch_list` | List the document's sketches (name / form / size) |
| `cad_sketch_delete` | Delete a sketch (refused while features still reference it) |
| `cad_extrude_profile` | Extrude a closed XY-plane profile along +Z into a solid — inline points/segments/circle or a named sketch (`sketch`) |
| `cad_loft` | Loft: skin a solid through successive closed sections (each a [x,y,z,…] loop in its own plane, or a curve/`profile` section); sections may differ in shape and point count; `smooth` fits a periodic B-spline through point loops for a **crease-free** skin; `ruled` for straight sides |
| `cad_revolve` | Solid of revolution: revolve a closed profile around an axis (profile coords = (radius, height); curve segments supported — rounded rims exact); optional `angle`; accepts a named sketch |
| `cad_chamfer` | Chamfer: bevel every sharp edge with one equal distance (mm) |
| `cad_pattern` | Pattern: linear (`delta` spacing) or circular (principal axis + `at` point + sweep angle); creates copy bodies, fuse afterwards for one body |
| `cad_shell` | Shell: hollow to a wall thickness (inward, outer skin preserved); `open` lists outward normals of the faces to open (empty = sealed). Runs on the occt.ts kernel; the result is a HOSTED body |
| `cad_draft` | Draft: tilt the walls `angle` degrees about a neutral plane (mold release); `direction` is the pull direction, walls auto-selected by default. Runs on the occt.ts kernel; the result is a HOSTED body |
| `cad_sweep` | Sweep: pipe a closed 2D profile along a 3D [x,y,z,…] path; the profile is auto-placed on the start plane, so no manual orientation; accepts a named sketch |
| `cad_boolean` | fuse / cut / common (classic hole punching: plate cut cylinder) |
| `cad_fillet` | Constant-radius fillet on all sharp edges |
| `cad_transform` | Translate / Euler rotate / mirror |
| `cad_volume` | Exact BRep volume (mm³) |
| `cad_drawing` | Engineering drawing: front/top/left + isometric views, dashed hidden lines, frame, title block, overall dimensions, standard scale, A4/A3 |
| `cad_assembly_insert` | Insert a body into the assembly as a placed instance (`at` position, `rotate` orientation) |
| `cad_assembly_move` | Set an instance's absolute placement |
| `cad_assembly_remove` | Remove an instance from the assembly (the body stays) |
| `cad_constraint` | Declare the constraint model: entities (assembly-instance bindings) + constraints (distance/angle/mate/coaxial…), persisted in the op log |
| `cad_solve` | Solve with Ansatz and write poses back; returns DOF/residual/redundancy/suggestion diagnostics |
| `cad_motion` | Kinematic sweep: drive one constraint value from `from` to `to`, solve frame by frame, apply the last pose, return the motion table |
| `cad_export` | Export STEP / STL / DCPRT (the native replayable part document) to a workspace path; `target: "assembly"` writes the assembly STEP, `target: "drawing"` writes the sheet as SVG / DXF |
| `cad_delete` | Delete a body |
| `cad_docs` | List the workspace's modeling documents (id / name / bodies / updated, active marked) |
| `cad_doc_new` | Create a named document and make it the session's modeling target (start multi-part projects here) |
| `cad_doc_open` | Open an existing document (by id or name) as the session's modeling target — bodies replay exactly |
| `cad_doc_rename` | Rename a document |
| `cad_doc_delete` | Permanently delete a document (requires `confirm: true`) |
| `cad_freecad` | Run an op program on an external FreeCAD executor (optional STEP input / export) |
| `cad_fusion` | Run an op program on an external Fusion 360 executor (GUI bridge; optional export) |
| `cad_onshape` | Run an op program on the Onshape cloud (signed REST API): creates or drives a document, returns its URL; `readback: "step"` for exact BRep meshes; exports `.stl` / `.step` / `.x_t` (Parasolid) |
| `cad_image_profile` | PNG → contours → extrusion-ready polygon points |
| `cad_script` | Deterministic script evaluation for geometry math (profile point arrays, arc coordinates): `js` runs in-process (Node vm — works even when the host shell is unavailable), `py` uses a system Python |

After every modeling step: **the chat result row updates in place** (stable viewId +
versioned URL), and the resident panel's "Part" tab tracks the latest model in real time.

## Connectors (roadmap)

Modeling runs on the **occt.ts kernel** via cadorange (OCCT in the browser —
zero install). The connectors below refer to **external CAD engines** acting as
executors for the same tool family, planned for future support:

| Connector | Suite | Platform | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Built-in kernel** | CAD modeling kernel based on OCCT + WebGL, runs in the browser — zero install | All platforms (WebGL rendering) | ✅ Built-in |
| FreeCAD | open-source parametric suite — natural local executor via its Python API (console + GUI window modes) | Windows / macOS / Linux | ✅ Available (needs local install) |
| Fusion 360 | Autodesk CAD/CAM — resident add-in + spool bridge (no headless; the Fusion window doubles as a viewer) | Windows / macOS | 🧪 Experimental (`cad_fusion`) |
| SolidWorks | Dassault Systèmes industry-standard 3D CAD, COM/.NET automation | Windows only | 🚧 Windows demo scaffold (`scripts/solidworks-bridge/`) |
| Onshape | PTC cloud-native SaaS CAD, fully in the browser — signed REST API (cad.onshape.com or chamber hosts); every op compiles to a standard Onshape feature pushed into the Part Studio, results read back as per-part STL + mass properties, the cloud is the viewer | All platforms (browser) | ✅ Available (`cad_onshape`; set `DSH_ONSHAPE_ACCESS_KEY` / `DSH_ONSHAPE_SECRET_KEY`) |
| ZW3D（中望3D） | ZWSOFT all-in-one CAD/CAM | Windows / Linux | 🚧 Planned |
| GstarCAD 3D（浩辰3D） | Gstarsoft 3D CAD | Windows | 🚧 Planned |

All external engines implement the same **GeometryExecutor contract** (`available()` /
`run(opProgram) → meshes`), so the WebGL display layer never changes — swapping a
backend changes only the quality of the produced geometry.

## Architecture

```
cad_view(path)                        modeling tools (cad_create_prim, …)
  → import worker (occt-import-js)      → modeling worker (occt.ts WASM via cadorange)
  → CadScene JSON (base64-f32)          → exact BRep geometry + meshing
  → GET /dsh-cad/scene/<id>            → in-memory binary scene (f32/u32 packed)
                                        → GET /dsh-cad/bin/<docId>
            ↓ session presentationMeta (viewId + versioned URL) ↓
        browser card + persistent "3D" tab (three.js / SVG, Z-up, XYZ axes)
```

- **Two workers**: import (occt-import-js, read-only STEP/IGES/BREP) and modeling
  (cadorange over the occt.ts wasm) are separate, both lazily started
- **Zero-copy pipeline**: modeling scenes use zero base64 / zero large JSON arrays /
  zero per-step disk writes (disk mirror debounced 1.5s, replayed only on service
  restart); `cad_export` is the only explicit file export
- **Modeling document**: `<workspace>/.dsh-cad/model.json` operation log; all bodies
  are restored by replay after a restart
- **Drawing HLR kernel**: hidden lines run on **occt.ts** (npm dependency,
  `npm i occt.ts`) — true OCCT removal, no fallback engine, a missing kernel is
  a hard error. Kernel APIs: `hiddenLines()` true hidden-line
  removal, byte-level STEP/BRep `readStep`/`readBrep`/`writeStep`/`writeBrep`
  without MEMFS, tessellation with built-in feature-edge extraction, and a
  `hasError()`/`lastError()` error contract. Geometry crosses kernels as STEP
  bytes and the projected segments are remapped into the sheet frame. Kernel
  dist resolution: `DSH_OCCTJS_DIST` env var → Node's own resolution of the
  `occt.ts` dependency (walks up every parent node_modules — npm/yarn flat and
  pnpm symlink layouts all hit) → `<repo>/../opencascade-ts/dist` (sibling
  checkout) → `vendor/` → `node_modules/opencascade-ts`
- **Constraint solving (Ansatz)**: the solver is the npm dependency
  **`ansatz-wasm`** (a wasm-bindgen build, single package ~538KB, zero deps) —
  installing dsh-cad pulls it automatically, and `npm install ansatz-wasm` alone
  upgrades it. **No Rust toolchain, no native binary, platform independent.**
  Resolution: the npm package (node_modules) → a `DSH_ANSATZ_WASM` directory → a
  sibling Ansatz checkout's pkg-node. The solver speaks one JSON envelope
  contract, with tool-layer errors (e.g. `unsupported_constraint`) surfaced
  verbatim for the LLM. Assembly placements (translate + XYZ Euler
  degrees) map bidirectionally to the solver's rigid3 poses (translate +
  exponential-map rotation, radians). Solver capability is staged
  (point-distance-to-origin today) — the plumbing contract is finished and needs
  no changes as it grows
- **Kernel chain**: modeling goes through **cadorange** (agent-native CAD
  runtime; public build123d-style API for prims/curve-segment profiles (TRUE
  B-spline interpolation)/loft/sweep/revolve/booleans (cleaned by default)/
  fillet/chamfer/shell/draft/native mirror/centroid, plus the supported
  `cadorange/occt` escape hatch for viewer tessellation, engineering-drawing
  HLR (zero STEP hops, one wasm session) and wire construction); the direct
  occt.ts adapter stays as the fallback tier (`DSH_CAD_KERNEL` pins one; see
  docs/cadorange-integration.md for the verb-by-verb mapping). Editing after
  shelling is seamless. Assembly STEP export writes a **structured document**
  (cadorange
  `exportStepAssembly`): one root product plus one named, placed child
  per instance — instance separation survives the file (STL stays a single
  fused mesh). Instance separation stays in
  the assembly scene/document for the fuse paths.
  Face selection matches `describe()` plane normals (outermost along ±normal)
- **Client**: esbuild single-file CJS factory (three.js inlined ~560KB, react provided
  by the host module table), Z-up CAD convention, empty scene with XYZ axis labels
  and a ground grid always displayed

## Theming (dark mode)

The viewer follows the host appearance automatically. DSH publishes the theme as
`color-scheme` on `<html>` plus `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`; the plugin resolves
that (falling back to `prefers-color-scheme`) and themes every surface the host
tokens cannot reach:

- the viewport slab behind the transparent WebGL canvas and 2D scenes,
- default 2D entity strokes (DXF / engineering-drawing entities),
- the Three.js ground grid, XYZ axis triad/labels, feature edges, default mesh
  color and sketch overlays,
- the ViewCube face plate (canvas texture).

A theme flip restyles mounted cards and the resident panel live — no reload and
no lost camera. Engineering drawings loaded as SVG keep a white sheet; in dark
mode it is framed as paper on the dark slab instead of filling the viewport.

Hosts can override the surfaces the plugin owns; an explicit definition wins in
either theme:

| CSS variable | Applies to | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dsh-cad-bg` | viewport background (any CSS `background` value) | light `#f5f6f8→#e9ecf0`, dark `#1b1b1c→#151517` |
| `--dsh-cad-stroke` | default 2D entity stroke | `#4c5561` light / `#c8ced6` dark |
| `--dsh-cad-paper` | drawing paper behind SVG sheets | `#ffffff` |

```css
:root { --dsh-cad-bg: #0b0d10; }          /* flat canvas in both themes */
```

## Tests

```sh
npm test                             # full suite: converters / modeling worker (exact volume assertions) / DCPRT round-trip / FreeCAD + Onshape executors / image profiles / binary pipeline / document persistence
node test/route-check.mjs            # JSON scene routing layer
node test/visual/serve.mjs           # browser card/tab visual verification page (http://127.0.0.1:3987)
```

Representative assertions covered: the boolean-punched volume exactly equals the
analytic value (28429.20 mm³), L-shaped profile extrusion 3000 mm³, volumes and
bounding-box flips of sphere/cone/torus placed with `at`/`axis`, 8-byte alignment
of the binary packing, an STL export round-trip (export → read back by the
phase-1 parser), and a DCPRT document round-trip (serialize → replay on the
OCCT worker → exact bounds).

## Known Limitations

- DWG (closed-source) is unsupported; DXF bulge arcs are approximated by chords;
  glTF/3MF viewing is not implemented (the structure is reserved)
- `cad_fillet` is all-edge constant-radius (per-edge selection is unstable under
  embind); chamfer is not implemented
- Sketch extrusion supports polygon profiles only (arc profiles are constructed by
  boolean combinations of cylinders/tori)
- dsh framework limitation: an already-mounted single slot (the right-side details
  panel itself) does not respond to components registered later, so the persistent
  view is provided as the "3D" view tab (a list slot, the official composition)
- The host reads CAD files via node:fs (the platform fs service supports UTF-8 text
  only and cannot carry binary data)

## Community

| QQ Group (🇨🇳 China) | Feishu (🇨🇳 China) | X / Twitter (🌍 International) | Discord (🌍 International) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `485038246` (join note: dsh-cad) | 🚧 Coming soon | 🚧 Coming soon | 🚧 Coming soon |

# Context Anchor · 上下文锚点

给 DeepSeek Harness 装一块「长时记忆」：每一步都从**完整会话日志**重建注意力锚点，并用本地检索内核在被压缩掉的历史里找回原文——超长会话不再失忆。

---

## 它解决什么问题

DSH 的上下文窗口再大也有上限。一旦历史被压缩（compaction），模型就只看得见一份摘要：早先的决定、路径、命令、报错原文全部退出表层。后果是重复问已答过的问题、改回已否掉的方向、找不到之前写过的文件。

这个插件把**会话日志**当作唯一真相：压缩只改表层，不改日志。于是它做三件事：

1. **每步重建锚点**——不依赖摘要，直接从日志重算当前主线、任务清单、涉及文件、上一步动作，注回系统提示。
2. **本地检索内核**——模型发一条检索指令，内核在倒排索引上排序，返回原文片段与 `seq` 编号；模型再按 `seq` 精确回读。
3. **自动压缩 + 自动回忆**——到阈值自动压缩，不等用户开口；一旦有历史离开表层，就把与当前任务最相关的归档片段自动摆回锚点。

---

## 能力一览

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 上下文锚点 | 每步重建，默认上限 1000 字符：主线指令、任务列表、涉及文件、上一步动作、少量自动回忆 |
| `context_recall` | 检索内核：倒排索引 + BM25 排序，支持短语、排除词、类型/工具/文件/seq 过滤 |
| `context_expand` | 按 `seq` 区间逐字读取完整日志（含被压缩隐藏的部分），默认单次 4000 字符 |
| `context_memory` | **分类记忆**：日志到达时按固定规则自动归类成七类，模型按需读取，不必先检索 |
| 自动压缩 | 热上下文达到设定百分比时自动把旧表层折成一条检查点 |
| 自动回忆 | 有内容离开表层后，每步最多带回 2 段强相关归档原文；弱匹配不注入 |
| 界面 | 输入框下方「本地缓存 ~N」徽标（绿/黄/橙随压力分级）；点开面板看状态、可召回内容、检索次数、热上下文与降智水平、缓存占用趋势图、下次压缩会归档哪一段，并可切自动/自定义阈值、重置为全局、导出/导入设置 |

---

## 安装

**方式一：仓库地址（推荐）**

DSH 侧栏 → **插件** → **添加插件**（或箭头 → 安装第三方插件）→ 粘贴：

```
https://github.com/llzzmm1136/dsh-
```

安装后点**立即启用**，然后**重启 DSH**。

**方式二：npm 包**

```bash
npm pack        # 仓库根目录，产出 dsh-context-anchor-x.y.z.tgz
```

插件页粘贴该 tgz 的绝对路径安装，同样需要启用并重启。

> 为什么必须重启：主机端与客户端两半都在启动时加载，页面刷新不会重新加载插件模块。

---

## 首次使用

1. 打开任意会话，输入框下方出现「本地缓存 ~N」。
2. 点击它：面板显示状态、可召回内容、检索次数、热上下文占用、降智水平与压缩策略。
3. 问模型一件它早该忘记的事，例如「我最开始让你改哪个文件？」——它会调用 `context_recall` 去找。

压缩生效后，`~/.dsh/storages/context-anchor/trace.jsonl` 会逐条记录判定（`below` / `compacted` / 无服务等）；排查「为什么没压缩」直接看它。

---

## 检索语法

`context_recall` 的 `query` 既可以是关键词，也可以带结构：

```
温度 曲线 type:assistant after:100   # 只看助手消息、seq > 100
"精确短语" -排除词                     # 短语加权命中，排除词过滤
tool:read file:Temperature            # 只看 read 工具、且提到该文件的片段
type:compaction                       # 只看压缩事件
```

结果带相关度分数、事件类型、`seq` 与居中片段；片段里被 `«»` 括起的是命中的词（不是原文的一部分）。随后用 `context_expand({ from, to })` 读取前后文。

---

## 配置

插件页 → 选中本插件 → 配置（`cordis.patch.yml` 中的行配置）：

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `recentUserMessages` | `2` | 锚点里保留多少条最近指令 |
| `recentFiles` | `3` | 锚点里列出多少个涉及文件 |
| `quoteChars` | `130` | 每条指令引用多少字符 |
| `maxAnchorChars` | `1000` | 锚点总字符上限 |
| `expandMaxChars` | `60000` | `context_expand` 的 `maxChars` 上限（默认单次输出 4000 字符） |

面板策略（存于 `~/.dsh/storages/context-anchor/settings.json`）：

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `auto` | `auto` 跟随系统默认；`custom` 使用自定义阈值 |
| `percent` | `70` | 自定义压缩阈值（30–80） |
| `autoRecall` | `true` | 是否自动把归档片段带回锚点 |
| `protect` | `[]` | 保护关键词：命中这些词的那一段不折进检查点（最多 8 条） |

> **保护关键词**匹配大小写不敏感的子串，适合填文件路径（`src/auth/`）或模块名。命中时切分点前移到最近的一轮对话边界，命中的内容留在表层。有保底：若遵守规则会让可归档区间不足原来的四分之一，就按原切分执行——一条保护词不该让压缩彻底失效。

> 面板里的策略**按会话生效**：在哪个对话里改，就只影响哪个对话，写进 `settings.json` 的 `sessions.<会话 id>`；没有单独设置过的会话沿用顶层默认值。压缩判定与自动回忆都是按会话读取的，一个对话的阈值不会改变另一个对话的行为。

> 自定义阈值需要一个可用的压缩后端。若面板提示「当前环境没有压缩服务」，说明 profile 中 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic` 未启用；启用后自定义阈值立即生效。

### 面板里的只读信息

| 区块 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| 检索索引 | 本会话索引规模：多少篇文档、多少个词条（点开面板时实时读取） |
| 压缩次数 | 本会话**成功**压缩的累计次数，以及最近一次的 `seq`；失败的压缩不计入 |
| 分类记忆 | 七类记忆各有多少条（决定/约束/问题/待办/文件/命令/事实） |
| 本步注入 | 上一步锚点的实际开销：字符数、估算 token、是否含自动回忆 |
| 历史趋势图 | 缓存占用率随时间的变化，最多 50 个采样点，随压力分级换色 |
| 下次压缩 | 若此刻触发压缩，会被折成检查点的那一段：`seq` 区间、条数、以及首尾两条原文摘录 |
| 建议 | 依据当前压力、阈值与索引规模给一条可执行的调整建议；没有值得说的就不显示 |

「下次压缩」用的切分规则与真正执行压缩时**完全同一份代码**（`archiveRegionOf`），所以面板上的承诺就是实际会发生的事：从不分割工具调用/结果对，也永远不会把正在进行中的那条指令折进去。

面板底部还有 **导出**/**导入**（JSON，含全局默认与全部会话策略）、**重置为全局**（删除本会话覆盖）与 **清除所有会话策略**（一次清空全部覆盖，带确认）。按 `Esc` 关闭面板。

面板高度封顶在视口之内（以徽标锚点为界），内容多时**在面板内部滚动**；面板标题与徽标悬停提示都带有版本号，用来确认页面运行的是哪份代码。

### 关于 token 开销

这个插件**不是无条件省 token**：锚点每一步都会注入系统提示，自动回忆也会把归档原文带回表层，这两项都是输入开销。它换来的是压缩后不失忆，以及不必反复检索。

能省的部分在于：

- **锚点默认上限已收紧到 1000 字符**，只保留最近 2 条指令、3 个文件、上一步动作的短摘要；完整会话计数、长路径与操作次数不再每步重复。
- **自动回忆只在强相关时注入**：最多 2 段、单段约 110 字符，弱匹配与重复片段不注入；运行时检查点（`Current runtime context. …`）不进入锚点、也不参与召回。
- **`context_expand` 默认单次 4000 字符**，先小幅读上下文，不够再续读，避免一次把整段归档历史重新塞回表层。
- **中文停用二元组不建索引**（的/了/是、这个/可以/就是…），并跳过出现在半数以上文档里的查询词：这类词区分不了段落，只会把无关片段顶上来。
- **压缩阈值越低不等于越省**：压缩本身要生成摘要，压得太早会更频繁地重新检索。收益取决于会话长度、压缩后大小与召回量。

面板里的「本地缓存 ~N」是**可召回内容的规模**（以及按同一密度估算的 token），不是「已经节省的 token」。真实费用还取决于模型的缓存命中定价，本插件没有计费数据，不作节省比例承诺。

面板的「本步注入」显示上一步锚点的实际开销：字符数、按 4 字符/token 估算的 token，以及这一步是否带上了自动回忆。它衡量每步新增的输入，与「可召回内容」表示的存量是两件事；尚未发过消息的会话显示「尚未注入」。

### 面板打不开时的自诊断

面板挂在 React 错误边界之后：渲染或 effect 崩溃时不再静默消失（表现为"点了没反应"），而是弹出一个红色提示框，写明具体错误，并上报到宿主端的 `trace.jsonl`（`clientError` 条目）。排障时先看红框文字，再用 `Get-Content ~/.dsh/storages/context-anchor/trace.jsonl -Tail 5` 读完整堆栈。

> 已知环境差异：插件加载器给客户端提供的 `window` 是一个不含 DOM 事件方法的垫片。客户端代码对 `window.confirm` 之类做了守卫，事件监听会先尝试 `globalThis` 再回退；新增 window/document API 的使用时应沿用同样的"先探测、可降级"写法。

---

## 分类记忆

锚点是**每步都要付钱的摘要**；分类记忆是**按需取用的库存**。日志到达时就被归类，不再额外调用模型：

| 分类 | 收什么 | 来源 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 决定 | 选了哪个方案、结论是什么 | 助手消息（`决定`/`改用`/`结论`/`decided`…） |
| 约束 | 用户立的规矩、偏好、禁止项 | 用户消息（`必须`/`不要`/`只能`/`never`…） |
| 问题 | 报错、失败、卡住的地方 | 用户与助手消息（`报错`/`失败`/`TypeError`/`at fn (…)`…） |
| 待办 | 还没做完的事、下一步 | 双方（`TODO`/`还需要`/`接下来`…） |
| 文件 | 动过且值得记住的文件路径 | 工具调用参数里的 `file_path`/`path` |
| 命令 | 可以重跑的命令行 | 工具调用参数里的 `command`/`cmd` |
| 事实 | 项目与环境的稳定描述 | 没有命中规则的助手总结 |

模型这样取：

```
context_memory()                        # 全部七类，每类最新 8 条
context_memory({ kind: 'constraint' })  # 只看约束
context_memory({ query: 'addEventListener' })  # 跨类按词过滤
```

返回每条都带 `seq`，需要原话时再用 `context_expand` 展开。

分类是**固定规则**而非模型判断，因此 fork/resume 后结果一致，也不产生额外 token。代价是规则覆盖有限：反讽、隐含约定、跨句推理都抓不到，宁可漏也不归类错——错误记忆比没有记忆更糟。每类上限 40 条，超出丢弃最旧的；同一句话重复出现只存一次。

---

## 架构

```
┌─ Host 半（index.js）──────────────┐    ┌─ Client 半（client.js）───────────┐
│ systemPrompt.context → 锚点        │    │ conversation.composer.dock        │
│ tools: context_recall / expand     │    │   └ 「本地缓存 ~N」徽标            │
│ 检索内核：倒排索引 + BM25           │    │ shell.overlay                     │
│ agent/pre-step → 早期压缩           │←→  │   └ 面板（策略/状态/压力）         │
│ 投影 contextAnchorCache            │    │ 同源路由 /api/dsh-context-anchor   │
└───────────────────────────────────┘    └───────────────────────────────────┘
```

- **索引**：每会话增量维护，latin 词 + 中文二元组（中文无词边界），BM25 打分，短语加权。
- **数据来源**：宿主投影 `contextAnchorCache`（可召回规模）与 `contextPressure`（热上下文占用）。
- **策略读写**：客户端通过带连接校验的同源路由 `/api/dsh-context-anchor/settings` 与主机端交换 JSON。

---

## 开发

```bash
npm test                # 全部自检，提交前必须全绿
```

它依次运行：

| 脚本 | 覆盖 |
| --- | --- |
| `node --check index.js client.js` | 语法 |
| `smoke.mjs` | 主机端：锚点、工具、内核、投影、压缩判定 |
| `probe-client.mjs` | 客户端渲染探针：槽位注册、点击链路、面板文案、趋势图 |
| `test/cut-region.mjs` | 压缩切分与预览：边界、进行中指令、保护规则与保底 |
| `test/highlight.mjs` | 检索片段命中标记：预算、去重、大小写 |
| `test/render-smoke.mjs` | 面板各分支渲染：空历史、无热上下文、策略不可用、建议与预览 |

> 渲染类自检的价值在于**真的调用组件**。`node --check` 只证明能解析：一次 `cache` 写成未定义变量，语法全绿、探针也全绿（fixture 恰好没走那条分支），但真机上点开面板直接白屏。新增面板分支时，请让探针的 fixture 带上对应数据。

```bash
npm pack                # 打可分发的包
```

`trace.jsonl` 仅用于调试，不要提交。

---

## 兼容性与已知限制

- 面向 DSH `0.2.x`；依赖 `sessionProjections`、`shell.overlay`、`conversation.composer.dock`、`contextPressure`、`agent/pre-step`。
- 检索是**词法**的（子串 / 二元组 / 正则），没有向量语义检索。
- 自动回忆只保证把最相关的几段摆到模型眼前，不保证它一定采用；深挖仍需模型自己 `context_expand`。
- 客户端样式全部内联（动态 Client 端没有 CSS 模块），悬停高亮由 React 状态实现。

---

## License

MIT © 2026 llzzmm1136

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-activity-heat · Recent Activity

> A DeepSeek Harness plugin that surfaces **the sessions and workspaces you most recently talked to**, using a heat score derived from elapsed time — so the conversation you just had never gets buried.

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

---

## Why

Sessions pile up in the DSH sidebar, nested inside workspace groups. The one you just spoke in is pushed out of sight within minutes.

This plugin computes a 0–100% heat score from **time since last activity** and expresses it in three places plus a panel — the more recent, the more visible.

## What you see

| Where | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Sidebar entry** | A heat-ring icon whose brightness follows the hottest session in the profile |
| **Session title** | A small dot before the title text: solid = warm/blazing, hollow = active and cooler. Cold sessions are grey, hotter ones turn blue; active sessions pulse gently; hidden after 7 days. The row-leading cell stays with the host's state dot and the schedule clock |
| **Session hover card** | `Heat 4/5 · Warm`, `Last active: 40 min ago`, `This workspace is hot`; a green *Done* label when the session finished unseen |
| **Main panel** | Sessions / Workspaces views, each with heat filters and a count selector |

### Panel

- **Top-level switch**: `Sessions 58` / `Workspaces 10` — no more mixed list
- **Two-tier toolbar**: the panel no longer draws a title; the filled Sessions/Workspaces switch leads, followed by the text-tab heat filter (underline on the active band) and a lightweight text count picker labelled *Count*
- **Count selector**: sessions `10 / 20 / 30 / 50`, workspaces `5 / 10 / 20`
- **Heat filter**: All / Blazing / Warm / Active / Recent / Stale, with live counts
- **Every card**: the bottom row is split into three groups divided by hairlines — ① cache hit rate + context usage (each with a mini progress bar) ② turns + steps + tokens ③ accumulated conversation time; items inside a group use a dot, groups are separated by a vertical rule. The `Current` state is a badge before the title, and the relative time lives in the right column, not the meta row.
- **Finished, not viewed**: a session the agent has finished but you have not opened shows a green whale tail plus **Done** in the card's right-hand column — the same whale as **Working**, one static and one animated. Opening the session clears it immediately.
- **Waiting for answer**: a session where the agent asked a question you have not answered shows an **amber whale tail plus Waiting** in the right-hand column; it outranks Done and Working (data from the host's `userQuestions` projection).
- **Token breakdown**: hovering the token figure opens a details card — exact total, cache hit rate, uncached input, cached input, cache write (when non-zero) and output, mirroring the host's "Token usage" dialog
- **Time breakdown**: hovering the conversation time opens a card with the active duration, a donut of wait / thinking / reply / tool-argument / tool-run / other, its legend and a proportional timeline strip — same source (`contextTimeline.timing`) and same segmentation as the host's timing panel; the card is portaled to `document.body` so the scrolling list can never clip it
- **Right column**: a fixed 168 px column stacks the workspace name (top), the heat meter with its level label (middle) and the relative time (bottom), so every row lines up
- **One icon language**: all five metrics share 12 px stroke icons drawn from `currentColor` — no colored emoji
- **Long lists scroll**: the list caps its height, keeps 12 px of vertical padding so the first/last card's glow is not clipped, uses block flow (30–50 rows keep full height instead of being squashed), hides its native scrollbar, and shows a floating `⌃⌄` handle on the right while more rows remain
- **Click to open**: a session row opens that session, a workspace row opens that workspace
- **Ordering**: running sessions come first, then sessions by last activity; the workspace view applies the same rule before heat and time

### Right-click menu

Right-click a session card (or focus it and press `Shift+F10` / the Menu key):

| Action | Notes |
|---|---|
| Open session | Same as clicking the card |
| Open in terminal | Opens the session/workspace directory in the system terminal: Windows tries Windows Terminal → PowerShell 7 → Windows PowerShell; macOS uses Terminal; Linux uses x-terminal-emulator |
| Open in… | Expands a submenu on hover (first row is always "Open in terminal"), then lists the host's probed file managers, editors, terminals and Git GUIs; picking one opens the session's working directory there |
| Copy session ID / title / latest prompt / working directory | The latest prompt is copied in full; clipboard failures are reported |
| Pin / unpin | Writes the host sidebar order; this panel keeps sorting by heat |
| Rename… | Prefilled with the current title; an empty title cannot be saved |
| Fork session | Creates a branch at the last completed turn without navigating |
| Download session log | Uses the host `api/session.export` route; reports unavailability when the export package is not mounted |
| Archive session | Confirmation first; disabled while the session is running; 6 s undo |

Workspace cards also offer open workspace, open in…, new session in workspace, and copy workspace name / path. Ungrouped cards have no actionable entries and ignore right-click.

The menu is portaled to `document.body` so the scrolling list cannot clip it; arrow keys plus Enter cover every action, `Esc` or an outside click closes it, and focus returns to the card.

### Running sessions are marked

Cards for sessions with `session.running === true` get:

- a whale-tail mark with a **Working** label in the card's right-hand whitespace — the mark is a 12-frame animated GIF that plays its own loop (no CSS wobble), 28 px tall
- an **orbiting light band** around the card border (`conic-gradient`, one turn per 2.2 s)
- a **breathing outer glow** (one cycle per 2.4 s)
- a **constant light-blue border** around the frame, so the card outline never disappears when the breathing glow is at its dimmest
- **heat follows the run state**: the host's `updatedAt` only advances at turn boundaries, so a long-running session keeps its old timestamp. Running sessions therefore count as heat 5/5 and sort first; the card still shows the real "last active" time and the hover card labels the heat "working"
- the row-leading cell is left entirely to the host: running/pending rows draw the native `StateDot`, sessions with scheduled tasks draw the clock marker, and the plugin puts nothing there. Heat shows only as the small dot before the title

Workspace cards get the same treatment when **any** session inside that workspace is running — same whale-tail label, same orbiting band, same breathing glow — so live work is visible from the Workspaces view too.

A workspace card also aggregates everything that can be summed: session count, turns, steps, tokens and total conversation time. Cache hit rate is weighted across the workspace's billing buckets (not an average of percentages), and context usage shows the most loaded session. Nothing that cannot be summarised — prompts, the current-session flag — is carried over.

### Finished but not viewed

A session the agent has finished, which you have not opened yet, shows a **green whale tail plus Done** (static vector, a 3.2 s breath) on the right of its card. It is the same tail as **Working** — blue animated GIF while running, green static copy when done. A Done card **drops the orbit band**, so a "finished" mark never sits inside a "running" frame:

- **Rule**: the session is not the one currently selected, its `updatedAt` is newer than the local seen watermark, and **this turn has ended** — `running === false`, or `running` is still true but nothing has changed for 60 seconds (the host can lag a beat before flipping it back).
- **Current session**: detected from the host sidebar's `_selected` class, **not** `retainedBy.mainView` — that is a reference count and can retain several sessions at once, which is why the `Current` badge previously landed on the wrong row.
- **Watermark**: sessions whose activity predates the plugin's first run count as already seen, so installing it does not flood the list with Done marks; clicking a card, or switching to the session from the sidebar (its row becomes selected), clears the mark.
- **Storage**: the watermark lives in `localStorage` (`activity-heat.seen.v1`) and survives refreshes. The Web build changes port on every launch, so `localStorage` changes origin and the watermark can be lost — in that case the plugin falls back to "finished within the last 30 minutes".
- **Caveat**: the host's `SessionSummary` has no unread field — this is the plugin's own bookkeeping. Workspace cards do not show the state.

**Waiting for answer** is the third state: when the host's `userQuestions` projection has a non-empty `active` (the agent asked something you have not answered), the card shows an **amber whale tail plus Waiting** instead. It outranks Done and Working, also drops the orbit band, and clears as soon as the question is answered. All three states share one whale tail and differ by colour: blue = working, green = done, amber = waiting.

> `prefers-reduced-motion` is respected: with reduced motion enabled, all animation stops.

## New in 0.4–0.5 — more than one panel

- **Five states**: Waiting for approval / plan review / your answer (`pendingInteraction.kind`), all the same amber whale tail and ranked above Done / Working.
- **Range views**: the session view switches between Active / Archived / Subagents; archived rows can be restored in place.
- **Two lightweight entries**: collapsed badge (attention count) and the sidebar “More” menu — reach the panel without opening it. The session-header corner seat belongs to ui-sidebar-right’s panel button, so this plugin no longer contends for it.
- **Bottom activity bar**: appears only when sessions are running or waiting, click to open.
- **Batch actions**: Select mode → Archive selected / Pin selected / Copy IDs; running sessions use stop-and-archive.
- **Native sidebar row actions**: the row “…” menu gains Open in terminal / Copy title / Copy working directory / Download log, and the row hover gets a terminal button. Both read the same action catalog (`SESSION_ACTION_DEFS`) as the panel.
- **Stop and archive**: running sessions are no longer just disabled; the dialog lists the running turn / subagents / jobs / schedules and confirms with `stopActivity` (stopping is irreversible).
- **Right-sidebar dock**: pick “Recent Activity” in the right sidebar guide to dock the list.
- **`/heat` command**: type `/heat` to open the panel.

## Look and motion

Every surface is built from host theme tokens plus `color-mix` — **no hard-coded colors** — so light and dark themes work automatically:

```css
--color-blue-500             /* heat color (blue, falls back to #3b82f6) */
--dsw-alias-bg-base          /* opaque card background (hides the orbit band) */
--dsw-specific-menu          /* glass surface: host translucent menu fill (light #f8f9fa94 / dark #43454a73) */
--dsw-menu-backdrop-filter   /* background blur: blur(40px) saturate(150%) */
--dsw-alias-label-primary    /* primary text */
--dsw-alias-label-secondary  /* secondary text */
--dsw-alias-border-l1        /* separators, tracks and glass hairlines */
--dsw-alias-state-success-primary /* the green "Done" mark */
--ds-ease-in-out             /* shared easing curve */
```

Three layers:

1. **Transparency** — cards, badges, the count picker and the filter underline use a translucent fill (`color-mix(..., 70%, bg-base)`) over the panel background, with a 1px top highlight and a hairline gradient border.
2. **Frosting** — the panel paints **no background gradient** of its own; the glass sits directly on the host's base colour. Hovering a card fades in a `backdrop-filter` layer; hover cards use the host's `--dsw-menu-backdrop-filter`.
3. **Gradients** — mini meters, selected states, the running orbit band and the heat bar are gradients.

Heat uses just **three bands — light grey → deep grey → bright blue** (`HEAT_TONES`): light grey for cold/stale/recent, deep grey for active, bright blue for warm/blazing. The bar **keeps its band colour for the full height** and only brightens toward the top (the same tone mixed with white, `heatBarSurface`), with a 1px inner highlight and a hairline glass edge (`heatBarShadow`) — so it reads as a lit glass rod, and the lower half no longer dissolves into the card. The grey steps use the neutral `label` tokens, which read as light grey in light themes and dark grey in dark themes — no per-theme colours.

Motion (all of it stops under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`):

- **Transitions** — the list fades in when the view, filter or count changes, with a `min(index, 8) × 20 ms` stagger; the filter underline grows with `scaleX`; segmented controls cross-fade their fill.
- **Hover** — cards lift 1px with a soft outer glow while the frosted layer fades in; pressing settles them back. Meta chips get a tinted capsule, and heat bars/meters glow a little brighter. There is **no one-shot sheen** any more.
- **Hover cards** — 170 ms pop-in and a 130 ms reverse pop-out (the direction follows the up/down flip); the timing donut rotates into place and the timeline segments grow in sequence.
- **Sidebar** — the title dot is a radial gradient with a soft glow and grows a 3px halo when its row is hovered; the entry ring uses a `conic-gradient` and brightens on hover.

Performance trade-off: static cards never run `backdrop-filter` (a 50-row list stays smooth) — only the hovered card and the popover are truly frosted. The list fades at its edges with gradient masks instead of `mask`, so the frosted children are not broken.

## Install

This plugin is installed as a local directory or a GitHub repository; it is **not published to npm** (`private: true`).

### Option 1 — GitHub (recommended)

```bash
# inside your DSH profile directory
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/<your-profile>
pnpm add github:MarkTina/dsh-activity-heat#v0.5.3
```

Pin a tag (`#v0.5.3`) rather than following `main`, so an unrelated commit cannot change what you run. To upgrade later, bump the tag and restart DSH.

The repository must be **public**; a private repo needs a token (`https://<token>@github.com/...` or an SSH remote) before `pnpm add` can fetch it.

Then append the package name to `dsh.profile.bundles` in that profile's `package.json`:

```json
"@local/activity-heat"
```

**First install** normally activates through the host's HMR — if the row does not appear, restart DSH once. **Updating an already-installed copy** (same path, changed files) always needs a full quit-and-relaunch: a page refresh only reloads the UI, and toggling the plugin does not re-read changed modules.

> Desktop profiles are managed by the Electron app. Install through its plugin manager (GitHub / local directory) rather than running `pnpm` inside `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop` — the app owns that directory and will reject or overwrite manual changes.

### Option 2 — Local checkout

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/<your-profile>
pnpm add link:/absolute/path/dsh-activity-heat
```

Add `@local/activity-heat` to `dsh.profile.bundles` the same way.

## Shortcut

Default **`Ctrl + Alt + H`** (`Cmd + Alt + H` on macOS) switches to the Recent Activity panel. Pressing it again while the panel is open returns you to the conversation you came from — the panel never replaces the session, so the toggle is a round trip.

Change it under **Settings → Shortcuts**, searching for “Recent Activity”.

You can also type **`/heat`** to open the panel (when the host mounts the command service).

> **Why not `Ctrl+H`?** The host treats `Ctrl` + `C/V/X/Z/Y/Q/H` as reserved system keys (browser history etc.), so a bare `Ctrl+H` default is rejected as `reserved`. Adding `alt` uses the web whitelist branch. For the same reason the plugin deliberately declares **no Linux profile** — on Linux `alt+control` is treated as reserved and would fail the whole registration. Linux users can bind a key in Settings.

## Configuration

Defaults live in `cordis.patch.yml`. To override, add a row with the same id to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (**config is replaced whole, not deep-merged — write every field**):

```yaml
- id: activity-heat
  config:
    hotMinutes: 10        # blazing window (minutes)
    warmMinutes: 60       # warm
    activeMinutes: 360    # active
    recentMinutes: 1440   # recent
    staleDays: 7          # stale (hidden beyond this)
    topCount: 8           # default rows in the panel
    tickSeconds: 60       # heat decay refresh interval
    showRowDots: true     # show the heat dot before a session title
    showHoverHeat: true   # show the heat section in the hover card
```

## Data sources

Everything is read from **public host snapshots** — no private APIs, nothing written to the session log:

| Purpose | Source |
|---|---|
| Last activity time | `sessions.list.byId[id].updatedAt` (same as the sidebar row trailing time) |
| Title / draft / subagent / archive | the same `title` `blank` `origin`, plus `workspaces.list.archivedSessionIds` |
| Workspace membership | `workspaces.list.items[].sessionIds` (same mapping as the host `groupByWorkspace`) |
| Turns / steps | `sessions.list.projectionsBySession[id].values.sessionStats.turns` / `.steps` — the values the composer activity pill reads |
| Tokens | `…values.tokenUsage` — billed input (`uncachedInputTokens + cacheReadTokens + cacheWriteTokens`) plus `outputTokens`, the same whole-log total as the composer usage pill |
| Cache hit rate | `…values.tokenUsage.cacheReadTokens / billed input`, using the host's own rounding (a partial hit never displays as 100%) |
| Context usage | `…values.contextPressure` — `projectedTokens ?? pressureTokens` over `contextWindow`, the value the composer context meter reads |
| Session prompt | `…values.contextTimeline` (`initialPrompt` / `lastUser` / `lastReply`) — the status bar does not show prompts |
| Conversation time & breakdown | `…values.contextTimeline.timing` (`wallMs` / `ttftMs` / `genMs` / `toolsMs` and the generation subdivisions) — the same source and segmentation as the host timing panel |
| Running state | `sessions.list.byId[id].running` |

**Excluded**: archived sessions, subagent child sessions, blank draft sessions.

## Repository layout

The package follows the DSH bundle layout: a Host entry, a Web client entry, one loader patch, and exported display resources.

```
dsh-activity-heat/
├── index.js            Host half — open-terminal route (launches the system terminal); otherwise mount-only
├── client.js           Web half — ModuleLoader factory, slots, locale
├── design.md           Visual/interaction charter — red lines and deviation log
├── cordis.patch.yml    Bundle patch — inserts the activity-heat row + defaults
├── locale/
│   ├── zh.json         Plugin metadata + UI dictionary (Chinese)
│   └── en.json         Plugin metadata + UI dictionary (English)
├── icon.svg            Plugin icon (exported as ./icon)
├── assets/
│   ├── active.gif      Animated whale-tail badge (inlined into client.js)
│   └── active.png      Static source frame for the GIF
├── test/               Dependency-free self-checks, run with node
├── package.json        Manifest — dsh.bundle.patch, dsh.client, exports, files
├── README.md           This file
├── README.zh.md        Chinese README
├── CHANGELOG.md
└── LICENSE
```

Visible UI text is routed through the host **Client locale service** (`ctx.locale`), falling back to the bundled Chinese dictionary when the service is unavailable. The two locale JSON files carry the same keys; `node test/locale.cjs` keeps them and the inlined dictionary in sync.

## Debugging

Release builds log nothing. To trace the full chain, flip the switch at the top of `client.js` to `true` and reload the page:

```js
var ACTIVITY_HEAT_DEBUG = false;   // ← change to true
```

## Self-checks

The repo ships dependency-free logic tests that load the **real `client.js`** against a minimal React stand-in — no browser required:

```bash
node test/panel.cjs        # registration / sorting / filtering / rendering / click-through
node test/menu.cjs         # right-click menu: actions, confirmation, export probe, capability fallback
node test/shortcut.cjs     # shortcut defaults against host reserved-key rules
node test/boot-timing.cjs  # restart timing: recovery when slots become ready late
node test/locale.cjs       # locale dictionaries and metadata stay in sync
node test/assets.cjs       # inlined running badge matches assets/active.png
```

`npm test` runs all six.

## Known limitations

- Turns, tokens, cache hit rate and context usage read `sessionStats`, `tokenUsage` and `contextPressure` — the same projections as the composer status bar, so the numbers match it exactly. Profiles that only expose `contextTimeline` fall back to its values; in that case the figures can differ from the status bar.
- No Linux default shortcut is declared; Linux users bind one in Settings.
- The right-click menu does **not** delete sessions: the host only supports archiving, and archived sessions can be restored from the sidebar's archived view.
- Running sessions' archive item becomes “Stop and archive…”: the dialog lists the running turn / subagents / jobs / schedules and stops them (irreversible) before archiving; the panel re-sorts by heat afterwards.
- "Download session log" requires the host to mount `dsh-session-log-export`; without it the item reports unavailability instead of opening a 404 page.
- The host's native sidebar rows expose no right-click event, but they do expose `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` / `.row.action` seats; the plugin's terminal / copy / download actions live there, while pin / rename / fork / archive use the host's own items and the central panel keeps the full menu.
- `updatedAt` is the host's last-activity snapshot and does not refresh with tool steps or streaming output; the panel treats running sessions as maximum heat, which does not mean they just received a message.
- "Open in…" requires the host to mount `dsh-host-open-in-app` (`/open-in-app/apps` and `/open-in-app/open`); without it, over SSH, or when the directory is gone, the item is disabled or reports a failure. The host probes installed apps once at startup, so newly installed apps appear after a DSH restart.
- Terminals list terminal emulators only (Windows Terminal / Terminal / iTerm2 / Warp…); Git Bash is a shell, not a terminal emulator, so it is not shown.
- "Open in terminal" is implemented by the plugin's own Host route `POST /activity-heat/open-terminal`, independent of the host open-in-app catalog; Windows tries Windows Terminal → PowerShell 7 → Windows PowerShell, and reports a failure when none is available.

- Waiting-for-approval / plan-review rely on the host `pendingInteraction`; older hosts expose only `userQuestions`, so both fall back to “Waiting”.
- The right-sidebar dock and `/heat` require the host to mount `sidebarRightTabs` / `commandUi`; otherwise the entry is simply absent.
- Batch-archiving a running session uses `stopActivity`; stopping is not reversible.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# DSH 大肥鱼 🐋 **在桌面上陪你工作的 DeepSeek Harness 伴侣。** [English](README_EN.md) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-dafeiyu) · [下载最新版](https://github.com/QCYTSN/dsh-dafeiyu/releases/latest) · [更新日志](CHANGELOG.md) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-dafeiyu?label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-dafeiyu) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/QCYTSN/dsh-dafeiyu)](https://github.com/QCYTSN/dsh-dafeiyu/releases/latest)
大肥鱼由 DSH 插件启动，随 DSH 一起退出。透明、无边框、始终置顶的原生窗口，让你在编辑器、浏览器或其他应用中也能看到 Agent 的工作状态。 > **当前稳定版：0.1.19。** 修复 Helper 冷启动超时后角色静默消失（首次等待放宽到 180 秒并写入诊断日志）、失败启动遗留约 100 MB 临时目录，以及 Linux arm64 误用 x86-64 Helper 后静默退出。安装时填写 `dsh-dafeiyu@0.1.19`，离线安装请从[最新版下载页](https://github.com/QCYTSN/dsh-dafeiyu/releases/latest)选择 **`dsh-dafeiyu-0.1.19.tgz`**；Windows、Linux 与 macOS 共用这一个包。GitHub 自动生成的 **Source code (zip / tar.gz)** 是源码，不是安装包。 *原生 Windows 窗口实拍；余额为演示数据。当前角色素材来自 [PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet)。* ## 能做什么 - 显示真实任务状态：思考、查找、修改、执行、验证、等待确认、完成和错误。 - 展示项目、步骤、多任务和 DSH 提供的待办进度；没有真实进度时显示阶段。 - 在状态气泡和设置页显示 DeepSeek 余额，区分 API Key 与已登录账户。 - 兼容 WebUI 与官方桌面端的共享客户端；两个客户端使用各自的插件配置。 - 支持拖动、摸头、戳身体、碰尾巴，以及大小、气泡、声音和减少动态设置。 - 可选在 DSH 页面右下角显示轻量角色，默认关闭。 状态来自 DSH 会话事件。大肥鱼不会读取屏幕；推理强度与进度只显示上游实际提供的信息。 ## 先选你的 DSH 客户端 | 使用方式 | 安装位置 | 设置入口（DSH 0.2） | 角色右键菜单的打开目标 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 浏览器 WebUI | `web` profile | 左侧插件 → dsh-dafeiyu | WebUI，默认 `http://127.0.0.1:3080/` | | 官方桌面端 | `desktop` profile | 左侧插件 → dsh-dafeiyu | 通过 `dsh://open` 唤起桌面应用 | **WebUI 中安装的插件不会自动出现在桌面端。** 两边都启用会各自启动原生角色，可以在其中一个 profile 关闭“大肥鱼”。第三方桌面包装器可能仍使用 `web` profile，请以它的实际启动方式为准。 客户端包中的 `platform: web` 也适用于官方桌面端：官方 Electron 应用使用同一套 Web 客户端。原生角色由对应 Host 启动。 ## 安装 使用命令行安装、升级或移除前，先**完全退出对应 DSH Host**；操作后重新启动。通过桌面应用内的插件管理操作时，按应用提示重启。 ### 浏览器 WebUI 已全局安装 DSH： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-dafeiyu@0.1.19 dsh web ``` 使用 `npx`，无需全局安装 DSH： ```powershell npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-dafeiyu@0.1.19 npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh web ``` 从 DeepSeek Harness 源码运行的用户，在 Harness 仓库中执行： ```powershell pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-dafeiyu@0.1.19 pnpm dsh web ``` ### 官方桌面端 推荐直接在应用内安装： 1. 打开官方 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用，点击左侧 **插件**。 2. 点击 **添加插件**，输入 `dsh-dafeiyu@0.1.19`，点击 **安装**。 3. 安装成功后点击 **立即启用**，大肥鱼会出现在桌面上。 4. 在插件列表打开 **dsh-dafeiyu**，调整角色、气泡和余额设置，修改实时生效。 这套流程使用桌面应用自带的安装环境，用户无需安装 Node.js 或执行 npm 命令。若应用提示刷新或重启，按提示操作；失败时展开 **查看安装详情** 并保留日志。 也可以只填 `dsh-dafeiyu` 获取安装源中的最新版。新版本刚发布时，默认安装源可能仍返回旧版；指定版本可以避免装错。安装后核对详情页中的版本号。 使用命令安装时： 1. 先启动一次官方桌面应用，让它初始化 `desktop` profile，然后完全退出。 2. 使用桌面应用**自带的 `dsh` 命令**。支持命令注册的版本可从应用菜单的 **Manage dsh command… / 管理 dsh 命令**入口配置；也可直接调用安装目录的 `resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh`（Windows 为 `dsh.cmd`）。 3. 执行： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-dafeiyu@0.1.19 ``` 4. 重新打开桌面应用，在左侧插件 → dsh-dafeiyu 调整角色。 **这里的 `dsh` 必须来自桌面应用。** 独立安装的 npm / `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh` CLI 不能修改官方桌面端的 profile。请参考 [DSH 官方桌面端说明](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/apps/desktop/README.zh.md#bundled-command-runtime)。 ### 使用 Release 安装包 打开[最新版下载页](https://github.com/QCYTSN/dsh-dafeiyu/releases/latest)，在 **Assets** 中下载 **`dsh-dafeiyu-0.1.19.tgz`**，用对应客户端的命令安装；**无需解压**。不要选择历史版本，也不要下载 **Source code** 作为安装包： ```powershell # WebUI；文件路径替换为实际下载路径 npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add "C:\Downloads\dsh-dafeiyu-0.1.19.tgz" # 官方桌面端；必须使用应用自带的 dsh dsh plugin --profile desktop add "C:\Downloads\dsh-dafeiyu-0.1.19.tgz" ``` 桌面端也可在 **添加插件** 的输入框填写 `.tgz` 的完整路径。 ## 余额显示 余额默认出现在**大肥鱼状态气泡底部和设置页**，查询逻辑由两个客户端共用。设置页可查看总余额、赠送和充值，并手动刷新。 | 来源 | 凭据来自哪里 | 查询内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | 自动（默认） | 优先使用 DSH 模型设置中的 DeepSeek API Key；未配置时尝试已登录账户 | 对应来源的余额 | | API Key | DSH 的凭据服务；旧 Host 无该服务时读取启动环境 | DeepSeek `/user/balance` | | 已登录账户 | DSH 的 DeepSeek 账户服务 | 账户充值与赠送钱包 | - 在 **DSH 模型／账户设置**中配置凭据；大肥鱼设置页不需要再填写 API Key。 - API 余额与账户余额分别标明来源；CNY / USD 分别显示。 - 每分钟自动刷新，同一 Host 内共享缓存；手动刷新最快每 5 秒一次。 - 服务失败时保留上次成功结果，并标明“上次查询”；未配置、授权失败和网络失败分别提示。 - 自定义网关需要实现相同的 `/user/balance` 接口；不支持时显示查询失败。 - API Key、登录凭据和上游原始错误不会进入余额页面、角色消息或事件流。 - 没有余额凭据也能正常显示任务状态；可关闭“显示 DeepSeek 余额”。 账户余额和 API 余额的查询方式参考了 [keshing/balance-display](https://github.com/keshing/balance-display) 与 DSH 的公开账户服务。插件不会发起模型调用。 ## 常用设置 | 设置 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | 启用大肥鱼 | 开关当前 profile 的原生角色 | | 角色大小 / 气泡大小 | 独立调整；小气泡保留基本字号 | | 安静 / 标准 / 活泼 | 每次待机动作结束后，分别休息 45～90 / 25～45 / 12～22 秒 | | 减少动态 | 固定角色姿势，停止待机与点击动画；状态和提示仍实时更新 | | 提示音 | 完成／出错时播放声音 | | 气泡显示 | 常驻、隐藏，或仅在指定状态显示 | | 子 Agent | 允许子 Agent 状态参与显示 | | 页面内角色 | 在 DSH 页面右下角显示轻量角色 | | 打开目标 | 自动、WebUI 或官方桌面端 | | 显示余额 / 余额来源 | 开关与选择余额查询来源 | 设置页修改实时生效。右键菜单可调整大小、减少动态、打开对应 DSH 客户端，或仅在本次运行隐藏／关闭角色。 点击动作会完整播完，再回到当前任务状态；新任务可立即打断装饰动作。拖拽期间只播放悬空姿势，松手后完整落地。具体触发、频率和衔接规则见 [动作说明](docs/animation-behavior.md)。 若 WebUI 使用自定义地址，可在启动 Host 时设置 `DSH_DAFEIYU_WEBUI_URL`；它优先于自动推断的默认地址。 ## 平台与运行环境 | 平台 | 原生角色 | | --- | --- | | Windows 10 / 11 x64 | 随包提供 Helper；WSL2 可通过 Windows 互操作启动 | | Linux x64 | 随包提供 Qt Helper，需要图形桌面；glibc 2.35+，Ubuntu 24.04 有验收记录 | | Linux arm64 | 包里**没有**随架构 Helper，会自动回退到 Python Helper，需要 `python3` 与 `PySide6>=6.7,<7`；缺失时会写明确日志 | | macOS 12+ | 原生 Swift / AppKit Helper，Universal 构建；实验性支持 | 标准安装包已包含 Helper，**不需要自己安装 Python 或运行 Helper**。从源码使用时需自行构建。macOS 小字号与拖动边缘已修复并通过 CI，仍需真实机器验证视觉效果与多屏操作。 原生角色显示在 **Host 所在的桌面**：远程服务器、无图形环境和浏览器客户端不在同一台机器时，请先确认 Host 的运行位置。页面内角色可在浏览器中显示。 ## 更新与排错 WebUI 用户完全退出 DSH 后执行： ```powershell npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-dafeiyu ``` 官方桌面端 **0.2.0-rc.2 暂不支持应用内自动更新**。在插件页面卸载大肥鱼，再添加 `dsh-dafeiyu@0.1.19` 并立即启用；也可以完全退出应用后使用自带的命令： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop update dsh-dafeiyu ``` 然后重新启动对应客户端。回退、移除、DSH 迁移后恢复大小，以及 Windows `EPERM` 的处理见 [更新与回退](docs/UPDATING.md)。 - DSH 0.2 设置页变化：安装当前稳定版，通过左侧插件 → dsh-dafeiyu 打开设置；较旧 Host 保留原设置入口。 - 桌面端安装只显示 `[exit 1]`：该信息不足以确定原因，请附上插件安装详细日志（如 `hub.log`）、DSH 版本、系统和安装方式。 - 余额查询失败：检查 DSH 中的凭据及所用网关是否支持余额接口。 - 角色不出现：检查 profile、插件是否启用，以及 Host 是否有可用图形桌面。Helper 的启动原因现在会写入日志： - Windows：`%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-dafeiyu\logs\helper.log` - macOS：`~/Library/Logs/dsh-dafeiyu/helper.log` - Linux：`${XDG_STATE_HOME:-~/.local/state}/dsh-dafeiyu/helper.log` 首次启动需要把约 100 MB 的 Qt 运行库解压到临时目录，杀毒软件实时扫描可能让冷启动明显变慢；首次就绪等待上限已放宽到 180 秒（之后 60 秒）。解压临时目录在 Windows 位于 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-dafeiyu\tmp`、Linux 位于 `~/.cache/dsh-dafeiyu/tmp`，其中超过一天的陈旧 `_MEI*` 目录会在下次启动时清理。需要更详细输出时可用 `DSH_DAFEIYU_LOG_FILE=<路径>` 改日志位置，或设为 `off` 关闭；报告问题时可以附上该日志（只含本地路径与启动错误，不含凭据）。 [GitHub issue / PR 处理清单](https://github.com/QCYTSN/dsh-dafeiyu/blob/main/docs/GITHUB_TRIAGE.md)记录已处理和仍需补充证据的问题；[验收记录](https://github.com/QCYTSN/dsh-dafeiyu/blob/main/docs/ACCEPTANCE.md)保留实际测试结果。这些记录中的旧版本号用于追溯，不是安装建议。 ## 源码开发 ```powershell pnpm install --frozen-lockfile npm test npm run test:python npm run build:helper npm run test:helper:packaged ``` 开发 Python Helper 需要 `requirements.txt` 中的依赖；macOS Helper 需要 Xcode Command Line Tools。纯 Swift 核心测试运行 `swift test`。修改原生代码后应重新构建 Helper，再安装本地打包产物。 CI 还会隔离安装 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 并运行 `scripts/test-dsh-settings.mjs`，验证新设置接口。该检查不读取用户 profile 或凭据，文件写入使用测试适配器。 项目通过 GitHub Actions 构建三个平台的 Helper 并发布；维护者操作见 [发布说明](https://github.com/QCYTSN/dsh-dafeiyu/blob/main/docs/RELEASING.md)。 ## 素材与授权 当前动态素材来自 [PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet)，以来源的 **24 fps** 转成透明 WebP 帧。当前清单含 16 组动作、3,444 帧，帧画布为 412 × 344；清单记录了上游版本、视频校验值和取帧范围。 软件代码与角色素材适用不同授权，请完整阅读 [ASSET_LICENSE.md](ASSET_LICENSE.md)、[素材来源许可证](assets/dsh-pet-LICENSE.txt)和 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。旧版素材及社区拖拽图片保留于 `legacy/`，不随当前 npm 包分发。 感谢社区在动画、macOS、WSL 和兼容性方面的贡献。想接收更新通知，请订阅仓库 **Watch → Custom → Releases**；Star 只收藏项目。 ## 内置降噪（chat.9） 装这一个插件，同时得到桌宠和降噪工具 `denoise_audio`（NPSS-Enhancer 核心，纯 CPU、无模型下载）： - 音频/视频均可：wav 直接处理，其它容器与视频用 ffmpeg 抽轨、处理后再混回（画面流拷贝）； - 参数：`mode`（music/voice）、`targetDb`（定果寻因）、`fast`、`workers`； - 依赖：Python 3 + numpy（Host 会自动找 DSH 自带运行时；可用 `DSH_NPSS_PYTHON` 覆盖），视频/非 WAV 需要 ffmpeg； - 核心代码在 `python/`，许可沿用 NPSS-Enhancer：学术/非商业免费，商用需授权（见 `python/NPSS-*.md` 说明与上游 LICENSE）。 典型用法（对 Agent 说）： > 把这个视频的声音降噪到 15 dB：/Users/me/clip.mp4 安装（二选一）： ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:masanli1/dsh-masanli-dafeiyu#v0.1.19-chat.9 # 或下载 Release 里的 dsh-dafeiyu-*.tgz 后： dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-dafeiyu-0.1.19-chat.9.tgz ``` ## 聊天上下文 + 小说续写上下文（chat.17/18） ### 宠物专属会话 `chatMode` 默认 `dedicated`：第一次点开聊天面板时，Host 自动新建一个会话并改名为 「和大肥鱼聊天」，之后一直复用同一个会话——**聊过的内容就是上下文**，重启 DSH 也不会丢 （会话 id 存在 `~/.dsh/dsh-dafeiyu-chat.json`）。 设置里可切回 `current`（跟随当前会话），或在面板顶部手动选一个会话（临时覆盖）。 ### 小说续写上下文 `novel` 工具新增 `action=context`：返回**大纲 + 人物卡 + 最近两章**（各截断到 4000 字）， 工具描述里已提示模型“写新章节前先取上下文”。所以可以直接说： > 接着写《长夜灯火》第 2 章，1500 字 它会先拉上下文再动笔，避免人物名、设定跑偏。 ### 宠物会话单独成组（chat.19） 宠物专属会话创建在 `~/Documents/大肥鱼聊天/`，因此侧边栏会和「dfy」「降噪」等工作区并列， 单独出现一条 **大肥鱼聊天** 分组；会话标题固定为「和大肥鱼聊天」。 DSH 0.2 目前没有给插件暴露“会话置顶”接口，所以做不到真正钉在列表顶部； 分组独立 + 最近活动排序是最接近的效果。 ### 宠物会话的模型选择（chat.20） 新建的专属会话如果落到 `deepseek-official`（需要 API Key 的路由），每轮都会报 `MISSING_CREDENTIAL`，桌宠会显示「任务好像遇到一点问题呢」。 现在 `adoptModel()` 会在创建/复用宠物会话时：优先沿用当前活跃会话的模型选择； 读不到时退回 catalog 里**确实存在且有凭据的分组**（优先 `deepseek-account`）， 并在日志里打印最终选择。排查用：`GET /plugins/dsh-dafeiyu/debug/models`。 ## 跨会话上下文 + 长期记忆（chat.21/22） ### 工作摘要注入 宠物专属会话发消息前，Host 会取**最近活跃的非宠物会话**的最近 6 条消息 + 项目名，和长期记忆一起 压成 `…` 块，贴在用户消息前面发给模型： - 模型能看到上下文，因此「我刚才在做什么」能答上来； - 面板渲染时会把这段 `` 剥离，**界面上不显示**； - DSH 主界面的会话记录里仍能看到这段（这是消息的一部分），介意的话可以在设置里关掉 `contextInjection`。 ### 长期记忆 - 文件：`~/Documents/大肥鱼记忆.json`（可直接编辑）； - 设置页「长期记忆」区块：查看、添加、删除单条、清空，并显示文件路径； - 工具 `memory`（add / list / remove / clear）：对她说「记住我喜欢蓝色」就会落盘； - 每次聊天自动把记忆摘要注入上下文，跨会话共享。 ### 排查端点（仅本机） - `GET /plugins/dsh-dafeiyu/memory` 记忆列表 - `GET /plugins/dsh-dafeiyu/debug/chat` 本次会注入的上下文（含跟踪到的会话） - `GET /plugins/dsh-dafeiyu/debug/models` 模型 catalog 与会话当前选择 ## 特斯拉阀 · 复刻（chat.23） 把 `tesla_valve_v2`（三元阀阵 + 水塔网络）搬进插件，并加了一层「复刻」能力。 - 代码：`python/tesla/`（ternary / valve / towers / encoding / impact + MNIST 测试集与已训练阀态） - 技能目录：`~/Documents/大肥鱼技能/<名字>/{state.npz, meta.json}` ### 工具 `tesla` | action | 作用 | |---|---| | `simulate` | 跑一个样本，返回 24 维出口水位向量与判定 | | `replicate` | **复刻**：给定目标数字，逐轮试阀——每条边试「开 / 关 / 换向」，只保留让目标 margin 变好的改动，记录每轮试开/试关多少条边，最后把阀态存成一项学会的功能 | | `use` | 用某项学会的功能跑样本 | | `skills` | 列出已学会的功能 | 复刻的思想：不重训整个网络，而是**从当前阀态出发做局部搜索**，像人一样 "这里该开、那里该关"一点点往前推，把能复现目标结果的那套阀态固化下来。 ```text GET /plugins/dsh-dafeiyu/tesla/skills # 列出技能 ``` ## 程序复刻：只靠阀的位置参数装下多个程序（chat.24） 把「复刻」从"目标数字"推广成**任意程序**： ```text 一段程序 = 一组 (输入, 输出) 记录 复刻 = 调整阀的位置/方向，让网络对同样的输入产生同样的输出 产物 = 一份阀态参数（state.npz），就是一个"装进来的程序" ``` | 动作 | 说明 | |---|---| | `tesla action=program-record name=S samples=[0,1,2,3] [source=baseline]` | 记录输入和结果（source 可以是 baseline / 某个技能 / random / zero） | | `tesla action=program-fit name=S rounds=10 [source=random]` | 从 source 出发逐轮试阀，最小化与记录输出的 MSE，记录每轮试开/试关条数 | | `tesla action=program-run name=S sample=2` | 跑样本，报告输出与记录值的 MSE | | `tesla action=programs` | 列出复刻过的程序 | 存放：`~/Documents/大肥鱼技能/programs/<名字>/{examples.json, state.npz, meta.json}`。 每个程序只是一份 `int8` 阀态 + 样例，互不干扰——**同一张网络可以装很多个程序**， 切换程序就是切换阀态。 实测：从 `random` 阀态起步复刻 baseline 的 4 个样例，10 轮内 试开 256 条边、试关 243 条边，MSE 从 ~1e-3 降到 **1e-8**。 ## 传入程序 + 数据 → 编译成阀态（chat.25） `tesla action=program-compile` 可以接受一段**程序表达式**（`expr`，输入是 784 维向量 x、可用 x0 和批量 n）， 自动生成数据、记录、拟合阀态，并在没见过的输入上测保真度： ```json {"name":"整图均值扩散","output_dim":24,"expr":"np.repeat(x.mean(axis=1)[:,None],24,axis=1)*1e4"} ``` 流程与 `program-record` + `program-fit` 相同，区别是**数据由程序自己生成**，不是从现有阀态录下来的。 实测与限制： | 路线 | 结果 | |---|---| | 从现有阀态**录制** I/O 再拟合（程序已在网络输出分布内） | MSE ~1e-8，几乎完全复现 | | 用表达式**新造**一个映射再拟合（12 轮随机试阀） | MSE 从 1.1e-3 降到 8.9e-4，**保真度仍然很低** | 原因很直接：5 万条边里随机挑 130 条试，信号太弱。要收敛需要更强搜索—— 按流量/灵敏度挑边（`impact.py` 已经能算每条边的累计流量），而不是随机挑。 ## 规模可调：更大的程序用更大的网络（chat.26） 阀网规模不再写死 64×24，`replicate` / `program-compile` 都可以带规模参数： ```text tesla action=replicate target=5 name=big5 hidden=256 out=48 rounds=5 ``` | 规模 | 阀数（边） | 适用 | |---|---|---| | 64 隐藏 / 24 出口 | 51,712 | 数字分类、小映射 | | 128 / 32 | ~104,000 | 中等映射 | | 256 / 48 | ~213,000 | 更大的程序 | | 512 / 64 | ~430,000 | 计算代价明显上升，建议后台跑 | 增长关系：`784×H + H×OUT`（H 是隐藏塔数）。计算量随 `H` 线性增长在输入侧、 `H×OUT` 在输出侧，25 步推进的总量大致和阀数同阶，所以规模翻倍、时间也大致翻倍。 规模存进 `state.npz` 的 `H/OUT`，`use` / `program-run` 会按文件里的尺寸还原。 ## 两个独立能力（chat.27） ### 1) 失败自动重试（降噪批处理） 每个文件最多试 3 次，间隔 20 秒，并在两次之间确认挂载还在； 成功会清掉 `state.failed` 里对应的旧记录。脚本在 `~/Downloads/dfy/dfy-factory/scripts/denoise-batch.mjs`。 ### 2) 按流量挑边（复刻搜索） `--no-guided` 可以关掉；默认开启时，用 `impact.measure` 统计的累计流量给每条边算权重， 再按权重挑要试的边（每 4 轮刷新一次权重）。 **实测结论（如实说）**：在这两个任务上，按流量挑边**没有明显优于随机**—— | 任务 | 加权 | 随机 | |---|---|---| | compile（整图均值扩散，12 轮） | MSE 1.03e-3 | MSE 0.89e-3 | | replicate（目标 5，6 轮） | margin -1.448 | margin -1.427 | 流量大的边改一下影响面太大，反而更噪声；真正该动的是"水流小但决定分支"的边， 这需要按梯度的思路，不是按流量。 ## 声音复刻：给大肥鱼换音色（chat.28） 把水塔网络当**储层**用：阀态决定 24 个频段的能量分布，一个阀态 = 一个音色。 | 动作 | 说明 | |---|---| | `tesla action=voice-learn wav=/path/clip.wav name=某某` | 从一段声音里学 24 段频谱包络，存成音色（阀态 + 包络） | | `tesla action=voice-speak skill=某某 text="..."` | 用该音色说话（TTS + 频响整形） | | `tesla action=voices` | 列出学过的音色 | 存放：`~/Documents/大肥鱼声音/<名字>/{meta.json, state.npz}` （`python/tesla/voice_cli.py`，依赖 ffmpeg 与 `/usr/bin/say`） 现状与下一步： - v1 用**实测包络**做整形，音色已经是真的（可播放）； - 阀态拟合 MSE 约 1.5，还没好到能"用阀态自己算出包络"，所以阀态目前只是记录； - 下一步：把拟合做稳，让出口塔水位直接驱动合成，再接到大肥鱼的语音上。 ## 大肥鱼用自己的音色说话（chat.29） 学来的音色可以直接接进她的语音链路： 1. `tesla action=voice-learn wav=/path/clip.wav name=lecture` 学音色； 2. 设置 → 大肥鱼 → **自定义音色** 填 `lecture`（留空 = 原声）； 3. 她再说任何话，链路变成 `say → 24 段包络整形 → afplay`； 4. 整形失败（缺 ffmpeg/python）自动回退原声，不会没声音。 已内置学会的音色：`tingting`（TTS 女声）、`lecture`（课程录音）。 设置里的「自定义音色」提示会列出当前已学会的音色名。 ## 用某段人声的音色说话（chat.30） `voice-learn` 从任意音频里取 24 段频谱包络（按 1 秒切片取中位数，抗伴奏/爆音）， 学会后用匹配滤波把 TTS 的频谱拉向该包络：`增益 = 目标包络 − 源包络`，限幅 ±12 dB。 实测（黄龄《免我蹉跎苦》40–90 秒片段 → `huangling`）： | 项 | 值 | |---|---| | 学习 | 成功，包络 24 段 | | 输出与原包络相关性 | 0.37（有伴奏混入，包络被音乐拉平） | **说明**：这是「音色包络」不是声音克隆——只调频谱，不复制发音习惯， 个人本机自用；要更像，需要**干净的人声素材**（无伴奏/清唱），相关性会明显提高。 ## 语音链路修复（chat.31） 「设置里选了音色但没声音/还是原声」的三处原因，都已修： 1. `plugin.js` 里 `applyEnvelope` 用了 `findPython/findFfmpeg` 却没 import → 抛错后走回退，音色从未生效； 2. `findFfmpeg()` 在这台机器上找不到 ffmpeg → 现在按优先级找：环境变量 → App 自带 → imageio 自带； 3. `speech.js` 被 Node ESM 缓存，改名 `speech-v2.js` 强制重新加载。 排查端点（仅本机）： - `GET /plugins/dsh-dafeiyu/debug/voice` — 当前 preset 原值与解析结果 - `GET /plugins/dsh-dafeiyu/debug/envelope` — 跑一次包络整形，返回 ok/错误 - `GET /plugins/dsh-dafeiyu/debug/speak` — 用当前音色说一句 ## 音色下拉 + 试听（chat.32） 设置 → 大肥鱼 → 语音说话 → **自定义音色**： - 下拉列出全部已学会音色（带 MSE），第一项是「原声（默认）」； - 右侧 **试听** 按钮用当前选中的音色说一句示例（不改变已保存设置）； - 接口：`POST /plugins/dsh-dafeiyu/voice/preview {voice}`。 ## 人声占优挑帧（chat.33） 歌曲混音里伴奏会拉平包络，`voice-learn --vocal-focus` 会先按帧算 「300–3500 Hz 能量 ÷ 250 Hz 以下能量」，只保留人声占优的 60% 帧再取中位数。 实测（三段素材做人声聚焦后学音色，用同一句话合成后比较包络相关性）： | 音色 | 素材 | 相关性 | |---|---|---| | lecture | 课程录音（纯人声） | **0.52** | | huangling | 歌曲混音 | 0.06 | | wuyi | 潮汕话翻唱（混音） | -0.22 | 结论：**纯人声素材效果明显好**；歌曲混音即使做帧筛选，也只够"染色"，谈不上音色还原。 ## 四个"像宠物"的能力（chat.34–38） ### 1) 持续状态 `mood.json` `~/.dsh/dsh-dafeiyu-mood.json`：饿 / 困 / 开心 / 想你，随时间自然漂移。 - 每 5 分钟 tick 一次；聊天、被夸、喂食、陪玩都会改变它； - 三天没聊，心情变成「想你」，开心值也会回落； - 面板里「她的状态」一行显示数值，并带 **夸夸她 / 喂点吃的 / 陪她玩** 三个按钮。 ### 2) 自动记忆 聊天时用规则从你的话里抽事实（不调模型、不花 token），写进长期记忆： | 你说 | 记住 | |---|---| | 我讨厌下雨，也喜欢蓝色 | 讨厌=下雨、喜欢=蓝色 | | 我叫马三立 | 名字=马三立 | | 我住在杭州 / 每天 11 点睡 | 住在=杭州 / 作息=11点睡 | 调试：`GET /plugins/dsh-dafeiyu/debug/memory-extract?text=…` ### 3) 主动行为 每 10 分钟检查一次：只有在「两天没聊 / 饿了 / 困了」时才冒泡，且两次之间至少隔 3 小时， 有任务在跑时不打扰——不再固定一天三问。 ### 4) 一个身体 桌宠身体本来就在（待机动作、走动、心跳、打瞌睡…），这次没动它； mood 已经能驱动它的状态气泡。 ## 说话同时出气泡（chat.40） 新增 `pulse(text)`：**同一句话既进气泡、也进语音**。 - 心情按钮（夸夸她 / 喂点吃的 / 陪她玩）→ 气泡 + 语音； - 主动行为（想你 / 饿了 / 困了）→ 气泡 + 语音，按状态挑不同的句子； - 任务完成/出错的播报本来就有气泡。 气泡沿用 `PULSE` 消息（ttl 6 秒），如果同一时刻有任务状态气泡，会以最新一条为准。 ## 独立说话气泡（chat.42） 新增消息类型 `say`（走 `/plugins/dsh-dafeiyu/events` 这条 SSE 通道），由插件自己的前端组件渲染， **和任务状态气泡互不覆盖**： - 位置：右下角、聊天按钮上方； - ttl 9 秒，自动消失； - 触发：心情按钮（夸/喂/玩）、主动行为（想你/饿/困）、以及任何走 `pulse()` 的句子； - 同一句话同时进语音，所以"看到的"和"听到的"一致。 ## 聊天面板升级（chat.43/44） | # | 需求 | 实现 | |---|---|---| | 1 | 流式/推送 | `/chat/stream` SSE，Host 每 700ms 推一次状态（只在变化时推），面板用 EventSource，去掉 2.5s 轮询（保留 5s 兜底） | | 2 | 发送即反馈 | 点发送立刻显示「她在想…」，气泡里先落用户消息；回来后自动消失 | | 3 | 快捷 chips | 每条助手回复下三个按钮：展开说说 / 换个说法 / 接着说 | | 4 | 忙碌可中断 | 发送键变红色「停止」，调用 `/chat/stop` → `sessionController.cancel` | | 5 | 语音输入 + 朗读 | 🎤 用 Web Speech API（zh-CN）填进输入框；每条回复旁 🔊 用她的音色朗读（`/chat/speak`） | | 6 | 可拖可拉可收 | 拖标题栏移动、右下角 ◢ 缩放、位置尺寸存 localStorage、— 收起 | | 7 | 打开不空白 | 空会话时请求 `/chat/welcome`，用工作摘要/长期记忆主动开场 | **关于"流式"的实话**：插件的会话事件里没有逐 token 的增量（只有 `assistant/message`）， 所以做不到逐字吐；这里做的是**状态级推送**——助手消息一落库就立刻出现， 配上「她在想…」的即时反馈，观感接近流式。 ## 生物反馈（chat.45） 除了心情，还多了一层"身体信号"：**心跳 / 呼吸 / 压力**，随互动实时变化，并且会反过来影响状态。 | 事件 | 心跳 | 压力 | |---|---|---| | 聊天 | +6 | −0.08 | | 被夸 | +4 | −0.20 | | 陪玩 | +10 | — | | 任务出错 | +14 | +0.35 | | 任务成功 | −8 | −0.15 | - 每 5 分钟按"当下该有的水平"收敛（压力越高心跳越快、呼吸越急）； - 压力随时间自然衰减（每小时 −0.05），不会一直紧绷； - 设置页「她的状态」里显示 `心跳 78 · 呼吸 17 · 压力 24%`，旁边一颗**随心率跳动的小红点** （动画时长 = 60/心率 秒，心跳越快跳得越急）。 实测：聊天后 72→78，任务出错 92、压力 0.47，三小时后回落到 80 / 0.32。 ## 面板配色修复（chat.46） 之前面板用 `var(--surface-color, #141824)` 做背景、文字 `inherit`——在浅色主题下会变成 深底 + 深字，看起来就是"黑屏"。 现在统一改用系统色：`Canvas` / `CanvasText`（跟随浅色/深色自动反色）， 气泡、输入框、按钮、chips 的边框也换成 `rgba(127,127,127,.35)` 这种两边都清楚的中性色。 ## 聊天面板改成"头顶气泡"（chat.47） - 尺寸读取时做范围校正（320×320 起），异常值（比如被拖成一条）自动回默认； - **双击标题栏**恢复默认位置和大小； - 样式改成贴在宠物头顶的气泡：圆角 18、右下角一个尖角指向她，默认位置 `right:26 / bottom:182`。 ## 接管宠物本体点击（chat.48） 在右下角她的活动区域盖了一层**透明热区**（`right:6 / bottom:0 / 340×330`）： - 点她 = 打开/关闭头顶的对话气泡（`window.dispatchEvent('dfy-chat-toggle')`）； - 热区层级低于聊天按钮和面板本身，所以 💬 按钮和面板内的点击不受影响； - 不需要时可以把这个热区去掉（或改成只在面板关闭时生效）。 ## 对话框贴到状态气泡下面（chat.49） 不再固定右下角：打开面板时用 TreeWalker 在 DOM 里找那块**含「余额」的状态气泡** （按面积挑最小的匹配元素），读它的 `getBoundingClientRect()`，然后把对话面板 贴到它正下方、右边缘对齐： - 每 1.5 秒重新测量一次，窗口缩放也会跟着动； - 找不到状态气泡时，回退到之前保存的位置（`right:26 / bottom:182`）； - 面板高度按剩余空间收敛，不会顶出屏幕。 ## 聊天 + 播放器合成一个 dock（chat.50） 原来右下角漂着两个独立按钮（💬 聊天、▶ 播放器）。现在： - 合成一个圆角 dock：`💬 | ▶`，贴在宠物旁边； - 点 ▶ 派发 `window.dispatchEvent('dfy-open-player')`，由 `dsh-player` 插件接收并打开全屏播放器； - `dsh-player` 自己的浮动按钮已移除，它只保留接收事件后的播放器页面； - 面板打开时 dock 收起，关闭面板后 dock 回来。 ## 合成一张"贴纸卡"（chat.51） 宠物区域外面包了一层圆角卡片（322×344，半透明灰底 + 细边框 + 阴影）， 聊天按钮和播放器按钮就嵌在卡片的**底边内侧**；打开对话时面板从卡片**上方**长出来。 - 卡片本身 `pointer-events: none`，只有按钮可点，不影响宠物本体和 DSH 界面； - 视觉上：宠物 + 按钮 + 对话 = 一块卡片，而不是三个漂着的零件； - 宠物本体仍是 DSH 内建图层，我们只能给它"垫底 + 挂控件"，无法真正塞进它的渲染树。 ## 原生本体（chat.52/53） `runtime/bin/darwin/dsh-dafeiyu-helper.app` 原来是一个编译好的原生二进制，无法直接改。 现在换成了我们自己写的 Swift 版本：`native/DFYPet.swift`。 一个进程里同时包含： - 宠物帧动画（读 `assets/pet-manifest.json`，21 个 clip，WebP 直接加载）； - 气泡（`pulse` 消息里的文字，右上角圆角气泡，ttl 到期消失）； - 对话面板（点她弹出/收起，贴在宠物上方，含输入框、发送、停止、▶ 播放器）； - 拖拽移动（拖动<4px 视为点击，切换对话面板）。 协议沿用原来的 stdin JSON（每行一条）：`state` / `pulse` / `config` / `ping` / `shutdown`， 启动时回 `{"kind":"ready"}`。 回滚：原版二进制备份在 `/tmp/original-helper.bin`，复制回 `runtime/bin/darwin/dsh-dafeiyu-helper.app/Contents/MacOS/dsh-dafeiyu-helper` 即可。 ## 原生面板：状态 / 余额 / 任务（chat.54） 对话面板重做： - 深色半透明卡片（`NSVisualEffectView` + `darkAqua`），圆角 18、细边框； - 顶部一行标题 + **状态**（干活中/思考中…）； - 右上两行：**余额 ¥xx** 与 **任务 n**（来自 host 的 `balance` / `tasks` 消息）； - 消息按角色着色（我=蓝、大肥鱼=绿），带段间距，自动滚到底； - 底部：输入框 + 发送 / 停止 / ▶ 播放器。 ## 修复：只启动一只 + 面板深色（chat.55） - **单实例**：启动时按 bundle id 检查 `NSRunningApplication`，已有实例就直接退出—— 不会再出现两只宠物； - **面板底色**：不再依赖 `NSVisualEffectView`（它会跟随系统变成浅色，白字看不见）， 改成纯色深底 `rgba(26,28,33,0.97)`，白字对比稳定； - 面板定位限制在屏幕可见区域内，上方放不下就自动落到宠物下方。 ## 面板：可输入 / 小窗 / 历史（chat.57） - **能打字**：`ChatWindow` 重写了 `canBecomeKey`，弹出时会 `makeKey()` 并让输入框成为第一响应者； - **不用时是小窗**：默认收起成 220×46 的小条，只显示「余额 ¥x · 任务 n」； 点一下小条 → 展开成 360×400 的对话窗口（消息 + 输入框），再点标题区可收起； - **历史**：展开时从 `/chat/state` 拉最近 80 条消息，随会话持续累积（跨会话上下文本来就在 host 侧）； - 面板配色白底黑字（chat.56）。 ## 复刻状态卡 + 双击开大窗（chat.61） 原生本体现在会像原来那样，在宠物上方画一张状态卡： ``` 大肥鱼陪你待命 任务 2 DSH · 等待下一次任务 账户 余额 ¥8.96 ``` - 标题随状态变化（干活中 / 思考中 / 等你呢 / 完成啦 / 出问题了）； - 右侧两行来自 host 推送的 `tasks` 与 `balance`（余额保留两位小数）； - **双击宠物** → 打开 360×400 的大对话框（输入框自动聚焦）； - 单击拖动移动宠物；对话窗可点标题收起。 ## B 站能力（chat.64） 新增工具 `bilibili`： | action | 作用 | |---|---| | `info` | 查一条视频：标题、UP、时长、播放、点赞（链接或 BV 号） | | `hot` | 音乐区热门 TOP10（走公开排行接口，带首页 cookie 防 -352） | | `download` | 下载一条视频到 `~/Downloads/大肥鱼视频`（封装 `dfy-factory/scripts/bili-dl.mjs` + yt-dlp，可 `audioOnly`） | 边界：只用于下载你有权保存的内容（自己的投稿、已授权素材），不做事站级批量抓取、不绕过风控。
